content.comment_body: Hi! I updated from [product_name] V8.0 to V8.1 but am now unable to connect to the device. I've attached the error message I encountered. Thanks, [user_name]
Which [product_name] model do you own? Is it [article_no] or an older version?
Could you provide a screenshot of your interface selection? Also, is your Java installation current?
Java is updated to the latest release. Attached is the initial error; then, every time I attempt to connect, a second error appears.
It looks like you may have installed the 64-bit version instead of the required 32-bit version.
I upgraded directly via the [product_name] V8 interface.
If I were you, I'd submit a support ticket.
Alright, I will contact service. Thank you for your help; I'll update you with the outcome. Goodbye.
Hi, after installing the 64-bit update from the [company_name] website, the problem was resolved. Thanks for your support and wishing you good luck and a Happy New Year 2017.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing difficulties connecting to their [product_name] device after upgrading from [product_name] V8.0 to V8.1. Their hardware version ([version_no]) and Java are current, but version compatibility and installation details such as 64-bit vs. 32-bit settings have caused confusion. The user could not resolve the issue without assistance, highlighting the challenge of navigating software upgrades and a lack of clear guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the upgrade process to be straightforward, allowing the [product_name] to connect without issues. They also anticipate clear instructions regarding software compatibility and installation steps.
